text: Tutorial gespielt und schon soll man 50€ im Jahr als Abo kaufen. Gleich deinstalliert!
author: Lorenz Riehle
developer_reply: Hey Lorenz! Sorry for the confusion. Levla is actually free, you can skip that screen and keep playing without paying anything. Over 80% of our players are on the free version. The subscription is optional and just helps two indie devs keep the app going. Would love to have you back if you want to give it another go!
